reviews.title: Great mouse for gaming and casualty use
reviews.comment: The Deathadder Essential provides a comfortable and ergonomic grip for extended gaming.  Its optical sensor offers reliable tracking, making it suitable for general computing and casual gaming.  The build quality feels sturdy despite its budget-friendly price point.  While it lacks advanced features, it delivers solid performance for everyday gaming. Overall, the Deathadder Essential is a good value option for those seeking a comfortable gaming mouse and reliable mouse.

reviews.title: Best mouse ever buy it (doesn’t matter that it’s renewed)
reviews.comment: This mouse is insanely high quality, i have a logitech super light and a roccat burst air pro and this feels higher quality, the side buttons are way big and it’s super easy to hit them when playing fps games, in other mice i’ve had issues where i didn’t like it because of the side buttons, it has a nice click for both the left and right mouse button, i didn’t even realize it was renewed, i never would have known if not for this review, its a great mouse you should buy it, its gonna be better than a lot of other alternatives and you cant beat the price to performance, im replacing my super light with this. This mouse looks and feels brand new and came in the box and everything, great gaming mouse.
